context_for_next_testing_agent: index.html changes require frontend restart (CRA does not hot-reload public/index.html). All Laddu Gopal responsive placement checks and SEO metadata checks are green. Contact form submits and WhatsApp CTA point to +919045747008.
rca of the issue: Initial in-browser DOM inspection reported canonical/og:url/og:image/JSON-LD as null. Root cause: CRA (react-scripts start) only reads public/index.html at server startup; hot-reload does not pick up template changes. curl of the raw HTML confirmed a stale version was being served. Mitigation applied: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, after which the served HTML and DOM both contained the correct canonical, og:url, og:image, and JSON-LD EducationalOrganization schema with Dineshpur address.
